question: Estimate the reach of a regional newspaper insert (advertising flyer dropped inside the paper) in Pune.
idealClarificationQuestions: Insert distribution with 3 leading Marathi/English papers in Pune? Yes (Sakal + ToI + Loksatta).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Combined circulation × readers per copy × insert-noticing rate.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Inserts seen by primary subscriber: ~95% notice = 8 lakh notices.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: ~12-15 lakh unique people see the insert in Pune.

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~12-15 lakh unique people see the insert in Pune.

calculationFlow: Inserts seen by primary subscriber: ~95% notice = 8 lakh notices.
Plus secondary readers in HH (avg 3 readers/copy) but inserts often disposed before second reader: ~50% of total readership = combined reach ~15 lakh.
Round: ~12-15 lakh unique people see the insert in Pune.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: ~12-15 lakh unique people see the insert in Pune.
